remarks: Commuter's dream location! Just a 2-minute walk to Springdale Metro-North station and approximately a 10-minute drive to Stamford Transportation Center with express trains to Grand Central.  Fully renovated townhouse offering space, comfort, and an unbeatable location for commuters. The interior features a bright, open layout with two spacious bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and updated finishes throughout.  The inviting living area includes a fireplace, perfect for cozy evenings, while two private decks provide ideal outdoor spaces for relaxing or enjoying your morning coffee.  Additional highlights include an attached garage, generous living space, and a flexible lower-level area perfect for a home office, den, gym/yoga studio or additional living space.  Located in the heart of Stamford's Springdale neighborhood, the home is just moments from local restaurants, cafes, grocery stores, and everyday conveniences. Enjoy easy access to Springdale Village, downtown Stamford's vibrant dining and entertainment scene, and outdoor recreation at Cove Island Park, Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens, and the Stamford Museum & Nature Center.  Enjoy the convenience of city amenities while still living in a quiet residential setting.
